description:
Replace exact text: old_text to new_text, or edits[] for several replacements. Any edits[] item may carry its own relative_path: the whole call then edits every touched file all-or-nothing (atomic, with automatic rollback) — the former edit_batch mode.
Use when: you make a targeted change. old_text must match exactly once unless replace_all=true. Pass expected_sha256 (read_file's sha256 or your last sha256_after) to refuse stale content and get a verified re-read.
Avoid when: you rewrite the whole file (write_file).
Output: Single file: replacements, sha256_after, verified (when expected_sha256 is given); failures leave the file unchanged (mismatch is numbers only; context.text shows the nearby lines). Multi-file (edits[] with per-item relative_path): data.responses[] each {ok, response|error}, atomic, rollback_succeeded, total_bytes_returned.

edits.description: Multiple section replacements in this file (or across files, with per-item relative_path); takes precedence over old_text/new_text. Any item may carry its own relative_path; the whole call then edits every touched file all-or-nothing.

relative_path.description: Per-item file: the item edits this file instead of the top-level one, and the whole call becomes multi-file and atomic (all-or-nothing with automatic rollback), like the former edit_batch.

replace_all.description: true replaces every match; false (default) requires exactly one match.

expected_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file's current full content. The edit is refused if the file on disk differs. Use sha256_after from your last write/edit of this file; read_file's sha256 only matches when the whole file was returned. When given, the result is re-read after the write and reports verified.

new_text.description: Replacement text (paired with old_text; ignored when edits[] is given).

old_text.description: Exact text to replace. Must match exactly once unless replace_all=true. Ignored when edits[] is given.

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative file to edit. Omit when every edit carries its own relative_path (multi-file call).

replace_all.description: true replaces every match; false (default) requires exactly one match.
